TaskDescription: Longitudinal motor-imagery BCI training for the Cybathlon 2016 BCI race; two tetraplegic pilots delivered sustained kinesthetic motor-imagery commands (both hands, both feet, rest) to drive an avatar in the BrainRunners game. Trial duration: 4.0s, cue: 1.0s, imagery: 4.0s.
Instructions: Perform the cued kinesthetic motor imagery (both-hands, both-feet, or rest) to control the BrainRunners avatar.
InstitutionName: Defitech Chair in Brain-Machine Interface (CNBI), Center for Neuroprosthetics, Ecole Polytechnique Federale de Lausanne (EPFL)
Description: EEG recordings and application logs from the two tetraplegic pilots of team Brain Tweakers (CNBI, EPFL) during longitudinal motor-imagery BCI training and the Cybathlon 2016 BCI race; this loader exposes the cue-based offline calibration runs (both-hands / both-feet / rest).
